about: An operation whose class requires one field takes a mapping, so the field's value written bare in place of that mapping fails validation at the operation as invalid_field_type, expecting the operation (SCHEMA-12). When the class requires exactly one field and that field admits the value written, the finding carries a hint naming the mapping that writes the value there, spelt as YAML flow text: a nested identifier or qualified variable stays as written, and any other nested text is double-quoted so the mapping reads back as the same value. A value the field does not admit either, and an operation that requires several fields, gets no hint. The mapping the hint names builds. #4629's first item. No engine output supplied these values: each path and expected class is the spec's own, each kind the written value's as schema_diagnostic_kind_label spells it (str, int, sequence), each hint is the operation's name and its one required field in yaml/schema_expression_date.yaml and yaml/schema_expression_core.yaml around the value as written, and the saved rows follow TIME-2 and EXPR-9 from dm.csv.
